_Please ensure these rooms are not assigned to any guests until further notice._

==================================================

* Cash Box: *$149*

120363421886767896 (Kiotel - Red Roof Inn Stroudsburg 1164): "A guest arrived and said her name was Chrissa Roberts. At first, we could not find any reservation under her name. She provided a confirmation number, and using that we found a reservation under Patrick Abraham, Room 203.

When we checked the profile, the guest name showed Chrissa Roberts, but the reservation was under Patrick Abraham. We asked Chrissa if Patrick Abraham was her friend, but she said no.

We then checked the payment information. The reservation had been paid by a card with the name starting with Jeremy Vargas. Chrissa confirmed that Jeremy is her friend and that he made the reservation for her.

We also checked the audit logs and found that the reservation was checked in by Krish Kumar under a different name, and the guest/profile information was changed to Patrick Abraham. The audit log also shows the payment and check-in activity.

The guest became very upset and was crying. She also showed us proof that she had paid for her reservation."

incidents.originalComplaint:
Hello Sir,

A guest named Bastidas Rodriguez Antonio came in and said that he is the driver of Danny Ruffin, who had reserved a room for him. We checked the system and found multiple reservations under Danny Ruffin’s name, but all the rooms were already occupied, so we could not provide him with any of those rooms.

He then tried to contact Danny Ruffin but was unable to reach him. After that, he mentioned that he had $45, so we provided him with a room for tonight at $45 and asked him to speak with the front desk in the morning.

Please look into this matter in the morning.

supportingMessages.text: Did you guys check in anyone in the last hour?

Incident Details:

The agent on duty accepted the guest’s payment and assigned a room. However, the guest did not arrive, and the room assigned was still dirty. The room was assigned by mistake because the guest specifically requested that same room at the time, and the agent was unaware that it cannot be been cleaned.
As it was already a busy day for the housekeepers too.

Corrective Action:

Going forward, we will ensure that room cleanliness and status are verified before assigning any room to a guest. We will also inform all agents and the manager about this incident to ensure that the same mistake does not happen again.

We will take extra care to prevent such issues in the future.
“No check-ins, sir and ma’am.”
Could you please update the guest that you guys checked in!

In what shift did this happen?
And how are we going to make sure this doesn't happen?

Sir, each shift has its own checklist, which varies from property to property based on their respective policies. We can implement one common practice: whenever there is a day-use guest, the agent can inform the main property group so everyone is aware. Additionally, we can include day-use guest details in the reporting and handover to ensure proper communication and follow-up during shift changes.

So how are we checking that each person is doing this? Let me also think on how this can be verified/reported so we have the gap closed.  Is there a checklist of things each agent has to complete (like a list of all tasks assigned to them based on their shift)?

We have informed all agents that charges for day-use guests must always be pre-posted. During shift changes, the incoming agent must verify all day-use guests and ensure that the charges have been pre-posted. If any charges have been missed, they must be posted immediately, and the shift manager must be informed so that appropriate action can be taken against the responsible agent if the omission was without a valid reason.

Hi @183219630637071 

Thank you for signing the contract, and welcome to the Kiotel team! ...
incidents.originalComplaint:
Hi @183219630637071 

Thank you for signing the contract, and welcome to the Kiotel team! We’re excited to have you onboard.

Please note that you may see a $1,500 upfront cost deducted from the account/card. Once the kiosk is shipped, I’ll share the tracking number with you.

As we move into the onboarding and go-live stage, I’d also like to introduce the team members who will be taking the lead from here:

Sarthak – Onboarding Manager @122549140754685 
Sarthak will be your primary point of contact throughout the onboarding process. He will coordinate the remaining requirements, guide you through the setup, and work with you to ensure a smooth self-installation and go-live.

Sean – Technical Head @42340089597972 
Sean will assist with all technical requirements, including kiosk setup, connectivity, configuration, integrations, and any technical issues that may arise during the go-live process.

Sarthak, please take the lead from here and coordinate with the property to complete the onboarding requirements and ensure a smooth self-installation and successful go-live.

From the sales side, I’ll be closing the communication from my end at this stage. However, I’m always available to support you whenever needed, so please feel free to reach out to me anytime.

Thank you again for choosing Kiotel. We’re excited to get your property live and look forward to a successful launch!

Best regards,
Vikash
Client Relations & Operations Manager
Kiotel

incidents.originalComplaint:
PM SHIFT - 10/14/2026
_*AGENT : Sakshi*_

INFORMATION

Room 224 – Donita England has a $100 RD on her previous reservation (6205416354157). Please make sure to release the $100 deposit from the previous reservation only after the guest has completely checked out.

Please make a key for the guest that remains valid until 12:00 PM instead of 11:00 AM.

Check-in Transaction Recording
We need to record all check-in transactions and upload the recordings to Google Drive. Each recording should be saved under the respective date folder and named with the guest’s room number for easy reference.

If any guest requests a folio, we can print it using the property printer named EPSON ET-2850 Series.

After the check-in process is completed, we should inform the guest about the pool timings and access code, as well as provide directions to their room.


Credit Card Payments: Currently, the property does not have a Credit Card (CC) Terminal installed. We informed Rakesh Sir about this, and he instructed us to collect credit card details from guests and process payments manually. Therefore, until further notice or complaints are received, we will continue processing credit card payments manually without installing a CC Terminal.

Check-In & Early Check-In: The standard property check-in time is 4:00 PM. If rooms are available and clean, we may allow early check-in after 1:00 PM by waiving the early check-in fee. For guests arriving before 1:00 PM, we may charge an early check-in fee ranging from $35–$70, depending on how early they arrive.

Call Transfers: Rakesh Sir will share the contact number of the hotel's telephone provider. Our tech team will work on the call-transfer setup accordingly and provide an update.

Booking System / PMS Inbox: We were not able to log in to the booking system. For now, we can use the PMS inbox to review and reply to guests regarding their reservations.

CASH BALANCE
Cash Recycler

I have verified my work and take full responsibility for the same.

incidents.originalComplaint:
*Motel 6 Flagstaff Kiosk: HANDOVER | AM
Date: October 17th, 2026


CASH BALANCE
▸ Recycler Open $734 → Close → $389
▸ Cash Box Open $100 → Close → $100
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
INCIDENTS 🔴



Important Instructions: -


1. Please do not rent any of the rooms that are out of order (rentables).

2. For any pest-related issue or bed bug report, please contact Steve Action Pest for a bed bug inspection.
Contact Number: +1 (480) 290-4078
As per Sam Sir's instructions, always call this number whenever a pest issue or bed bug inspection is required. The number is saved in the contacts.

3. Once a no-show is posted before the audit, no check-in is allowed on the same reservation. The guest needs to make a new reservation with full payment.

4. Please collect the card on file or deposit for the direct bill & VCC reservation. Also please confirm the number of adults & guest phone number.

5. We also do monthly rates—if they are paying by card, $1700 + $100 Depsoit makes the reservation in the PMS for the 2BF room type, & if they are paying cash, then it is $1500 + $200 deposit. Take all the details, like name, number & ID, and put that room in Renatble and Reson, which should be the other, and update that in the monthly sheet. The room type should be 2BF. 

6. Do not refund without getting the confirmation from Sam, sir.

7. Only the heater will work – no A/C because of cold weather.


- Arun Nair

incidents.originalComplaint:
Handover Report – 17th OCTOBER 2026
Shift: Audit SHIFT  
Agent: Deep Patel

*HANDOVER*
* #301 Rent to walk-in only 
Update: As per Div sir we might need to keep it OOO for another week.

*FYI*:- #406 – Housekeeping is scheduled every Tuesday and Friday, starting October 6, 2026, and continuing twice a week.
Trash must be collected daily from outside the guest’s door. If the guest calls regarding housekeeping, inform them of the scheduled cleaning days. Toilet paper, toiletries, and towels are available in the lockers for the guest to collect as needed.


* #As per Div Sir's instructions, Rooms 215, 217, 218, 220, and 222 in the 200 Building are the preferred ("nicer") rooms. Reserve these rooms only for overnight guests. Do not assign them to day-rate or weekly guests unless authorised.
* Verify the name on the card before adding it to the file. After adding the card, start the payment terminal by selecting the same card to avoid payment mismatches.
---

# Deposit Refund Policy
* *All deposits must be refunded on the same day by 5:00 PM.*
* Take a daily update from Debbie Ma’am on pending deposit releases.
---
# Housekeeping & Room Management

## Weekly Guest Room Change Policy
* Schedule room moves before Saturday or on Monday.
* Do not move weekly guests on Saturdays.
---

# Hot Water Notice – 400 Building

For all check-ins in the 400 Building:
* Inform guests that hot water may take up to 5 minutes.
* If it takes longer, guests should contact the front desk immediately.
---

# Extended Stay Form Requirement
Weekly guests must sign the Extended Stay Guest Form whenever they:
1. Check out and check back in, or
2. Start a new folio every 28 days.
---

# OOO Policy for Long Stays
As instructed by Div Sir:

* Mark rooms OOO a few days before guests reach 28 days to avoid accidental extensions.
* Mark rooms OOO once a regular guest extends or books for 28 days.
* Do not allow stays longer than 21 days for other guests.
---

# Operational Instructions

## Supply Locker Checks

Check the supply locker every:
* Monday, Wednesday, Friday
---

# Guest Complaint Procedure
For every guest complaint:
1. Report immediately in the group chat.
2. Call Debbie Ma’am or the available on-site staff member directly.
This is mandatory during every shift.
---

# Weekly Rental Assignment Policy

Weekly rentals should only be assigned in the 200 Building.

*Do not assign weekly stays in:*
* 300,400 & 100 Building

All tasks, updates, and instructions were reviewed and handed over successfully..

CLC Reservation Check-In Procedure CLC Hotels | Hotel Login
Before Check-In
Verify that the reservation is set up as a Direct Bill to CLC Lodging in HotelKey.
Log in to the CLC website and confirm that the guest has a valid CLC reservation.
Check whether the reservation is marked as Cardless or Card.
Cardless Reservations
The guest only needs to provide a valid photo ID.
Do not request a credit card for room, tax, or incidentals.
Check the guest into HotelKey as you normally would.
Complete the check-in on the CLC website using the reservation information from HotelKey.
Card Reservations
The guest must provide:
A valid photo ID
Their CLC card
Do not request a credit card for room, tax, or incidentals.
Enter the guest's CLC card number into the CLC website to complete the CLC check-in.
Check the guest into HotelKey as you normally would.
Add the guest's CLC card number to the reservation notes in HotelKey for future reference in case any billing or verification issues arise.
                                                                                                                                             
When checking guests in, collect all required guest information, including:
Full name
Address
Phone number
Email address
If the guest is a Travel Pass member, enter their membership number in the Notes section under the Stay tab.
Before completing the check-in process, review all reservation notes. Notes are located under the Stay tab and may be labeled:
Stay
Booking
Housekeeping
Do not authorize international guests' credit cards for incidentals or security deposits. Only swipe/capture credit card.
Guests may receive one keycard/Room Key at check-in, with a maximum of three keycards/Room keys per guest request.
Carefully verify all credit card authorization amounts before completing the transaction. Authorization amounts must match the required total.
Do not charge the security deposit. The deposit should be authorized only, not processed as a charge.
If a guest is a no-show, do not note the reservation as a fake check-in. Follow the proper no-show procedure.
OTA/Third-Party Reservations:
1-night stay: Process the reservation as a no-show.
2 or more nights: Check the guest in.
In either case, send an email to the Front Desk informing them of the action taken. (Front Desk email address: sonestafresnoes@gmail.com)
Regular (Direct) Reservations:
1-night stay: Process the reservation as a no-show.
2 or more nights: Move (push) the reservation to the following day.
After moving the reservation, send an email to the Front Desk notifying them of the change.
Process all market charges between 11:00 PM and 7:00 AM.
If the kiosk is setting up reservations for the next day, ensure ALL reservations are completed before 7:00 AM.
Run the Night Audit at 5:00 AM every day.
Be familiar with the hotel's amenities, services, and current offers so you can accurately assist guests. ( Attached is a list with Suite options and Hotel Amenities)
Answer incoming phone calls within three rings whenever possible.
Keep handover notes updated and current so the next shift has accurate information.

messageLogs.text:
Market Purchase Procedure
If a guest would like to purchase an item from the market and charge it to their room:

Select the Folio 2 box with MISC.
Go to the Charge tab.
Select Market.
Enter the amount of the item or items in the box.
Select Next.
On the second screen, select Next again.
Once the item is posted, select the Edit box next to the market post.
Enter the item or items the guest purchased.
Do not charge or complete the market post.
If the guest would like to use a different card or does not want the purchase charged to the room:

Select House Accounts from the list on the left side.
Select the account labeled Marketplace.
In the Folio box, select Add under Payment Source.
When the screen appears, select Add New Payment.
Select Credit Card, then select Via Terminal.
The guest will then slide or insert their credit card.
Once the card has been captured, you will return to the House Account Details screen.
Make sure the guest's card is showing in the folio.
Select Charge, then select Market.
Enter the amount of the item or items in the box.
Select Next, and on the second screen select Next again.
Once the item is posted, select the Edit box next to the market post and enter the item or items the guest purchased.
Once this is completed, you may complete/capture the payment.
After the payment has been taken, go to the top of the screen and select Clear House Account. This is important to ensure the guest's card is not charged for anything else.

messageLogs.text:
Market Purchase Procedure
If a guest would like to purchase an item from the market and charge it to their room:

Select the Folio 2 box with MISC.
Go to the Charge tab.
Select Market.
Enter the amount of the item or items in the box.
Select Next.
On the second screen, select Next again.
Once the item is posted, select the Edit box next to the market post.
Enter the item or items the guest purchased.
Do not charge or complete the market post.
If the guest would like to use a different card or does not want the purchase charged to the room:

Select House Accounts from the list on the left side.
Select the account labeled Marketplace.
In the Folio box, select Add under Payment Source.
When the screen appears, select Add New Payment.
Select Credit Card, then select Via Terminal.
The guest will then slide or insert their credit card.
Once the card has been captured, you will return to the House Account Details screen.
Make sure the guest's card is showing in the folio.
Select Charge, then select Market.
Enter the amount of the item or items in the box.
Select Next, and on the second screen select Next again.
Once the item is posted, select the Edit box next to the market post and enter the item or items the guest purchased.
Once this is completed, you may complete/capture the payment.
After the payment has been taken, go to the top of the screen and select Clear House Account. This is important to ensure the guest's card is not charged for anything else.

CLC Reservation Check-In Procedure CLC Hotels | Hotel Login
Before Check-In
Verify that the reservation is set up as a Direct Bill to CLC Lodging in HotelKey.
Log in to the CLC website and confirm that the guest has a valid CLC reservation.
Check whether the reservation is marked as Cardless or Card.
Cardless Reservations
The guest only needs to provide a valid photo ID.
Do not request a credit card for room, tax, or incidentals.
Check the guest into HotelKey as you normally would.
Complete the check-in on the CLC website using the reservation information from HotelKey.
Card Reservations
The guest must provide:
A valid photo ID
Their CLC card
Do not request a credit card for room, tax, or incidentals.
Enter the guest's CLC card number into the CLC website to complete the CLC check-in.
Check the guest into HotelKey as you normally would.
Add the guest's CLC card number to the reservation notes in HotelKey for future reference in case any billing or verification issues arise.
                                                                                                                                             
When checking guests in, collect all required guest information, including:
Full name
Address
Phone number
Email address

messageLogs.text:
Market Purchase Procedure
If a guest would like to purchase an item from the market and charge it to their room:

Select the Folio 2 box with MISC.
Go to the Charge tab.
Select Market.
Enter the amount of the item or items in the box.
Select Next.
On the second screen, select Next again.
Once the item is posted, select the Edit box next to the market post.
Enter the item or items the guest purchased.
Do not charge or complete the market post.
If the guest would like to use a different card or does not want the purchase charged to the room:

Select House Accounts from the list on the left side.
Select the account labeled Marketplace.
In the Folio box, select Add under Payment Source.
When the screen appears, select Add New Payment.
Select Credit Card, then select Via Terminal.
The guest will then slide or insert their credit card.
Once the card has been captured, you will return to the House Account Details screen.
Make sure the guest's card is showing in the folio.
Select Charge, then select Market.
Enter the amount of the item or items in the box.
Select Next, and on the second screen select Next again.
Once the item is posted, select the Edit box next to the market post and enter the item or items the guest purchased.
Once this is completed, you may complete/capture the payment.
After the payment has been taken, go to the top of the screen and select Clear House Account. This is important to ensure the guest's card is not charged for anything else.

messageLogs.text:
CLC Reservation Check-In Procedure CLC Hotels | Hotel Login
Before Check-In
Verify that the reservation is set up as a Direct Bill to CLC Lodging in HotelKey.
Log in to the CLC website and confirm that the guest has a valid CLC reservation.
Check whether the reservation is marked as Cardless or Card.
Cardless Reservations
The guest only needs to provide a valid photo ID.
Do not request a credit card for room, tax, or incidentals.
Check the guest into HotelKey as you normally would.
Complete the check-in on the CLC website using the reservation information from HotelKey.
Card Reservations
The guest must provide:
A valid photo ID
Their CLC card
Do not request a credit card for room, tax, or incidentals.
Enter the guest's CLC card number into the CLC website to complete the CLC check-in.
Check the guest into HotelKey as you normally would.
Add the guest's CLC card number to the reservation notes in HotelKey for future reference in case any billing or verification issues arise.
                                                                                                                                             
When checking guests in, collect all required guest information, including:
Full name
Address
Phone number
Email address
If the guest is a Travel Pass member, enter their membership number in the Notes section under the Stay tab.
Before completing the check-in process, review all reservation notes. Notes are located under the Stay tab and may be labeled:
Stay
Booking
Housekeeping
Do not authorize international guests' credit cards for incidentals or security deposits. Only swipe/capture credit card.
Guests may receive one keycard/Room Key at check-in, with a maximum of three keycards/Room keys per guest request.
Carefully verify all credit card authorization amounts before completing the transaction. Authorization amounts must match the required total.
Do not charge the security deposit. The deposit should be authorized only, not processed as a charge.
If a guest is a no-show, do not note the reservation as a fake check-in. Follow the proper no-show procedure.
OTA/Third-Party Reservations:
1-night stay: Process the reservation as a no-show.
2 or more nights: Check the guest in.
In either case, send an email to the Front Desk informing them of the action taken. (Front Desk email address: sonestafresnoes@gmail.com)
Regular (Direct) Reservations:
1-night stay: Process the reservation as a no-show.
2 or more nights: Move (push) the reservation to the following day.
After moving the reservation, send an email to the Front Desk notifying them of the change.
Process all market charges between 11:00 PM and 7:00 AM.
If the kiosk is setting up reservations for the next day, ensure ALL reservations are completed before 7:00 AM.
Run the Night Audit at 5:00 AM every day.
Be familiar with the hotel's amenities, services, and current offers so you can accurately assist guests. ( Attached is a list with Suite options and Hotel Amenities)
Answer incoming phone calls within three rings whenever possible.
Keep handover notes updated and current so the next shift has accurate information.

### – Important Payment Instructions

1. **No-Show Reservations – Night Audit:**
   If a reservation is marked as a **No-Show** and the card is charged, make sure the **name on the card matches the name on the reservation**. This must also be documented in the **shift log and the group**, including the reservation that was marked as a No-Show. Please make sure this is followed going forward.
   **Important:** Do **not charge any Postpaid RSVs** unless there are specific instructions from the hotel. Do not charge them randomly or without authorization.

2. **Sonesta – Card Authorization:**
   **Never charge a guest’s card at Sonesta.** All cards should remain **authorized only** unless the guest is paying for sundry items, pet fees, or other eligible charges with a different card. Even if the guest specifically asks you to charge their card, **do not charge it**.

3. If the guest is a per paid third-party reservation and here for more than one night, authorize payment and check them in and notify the front desk with an email. If the guest makes a direct reservation for more than one night, push the reservation to the next business day but not not charge them because their reservation is being moved, they are not checked in or considered a no show, so do not need to be charged any fees. It is now a new reservation for the next day. After this is done add to your front desk email.

4. Please inform all kiosk check-in guests about the map available in the cabinet next to the kiosk to help them locate their rooms, and have guests with pets or state/federal check-ins complete the applicable forms and place them in the drop basket in the same cabinet. 
 
*INFORMATION:*
* If the guest wants to pay separately by credit card, use the House Account and swipe the card there; if the guest wants to charge the item to the room and has a card on file for incidentals, post the charge to Folio #2 and complete the payment at checkout as needed.
* Alicia from Helix Company called regarding her employees who checked out of the property a few days ago. She has not received the payment receipts yet. She needs to be contacted by FHR to resolve the receipt/payment issue.Contact: Alicia — +1 619-758-8468(AM)
* If Any no show Reservation arrived go in action and there is an option of check/in then C/IN the guest.
* Please create miscellaneous folio before C/IN in any reservation only then you can able to authorize the deposit and this process is mandatory.
* Breakfast /Kitchen Staff: Arianna, Laura Aguiniga, or Jose Gonzalez
* Overnight Staff: Manjot Kaur or Jose Gonzalez
* We offer the Sonesta Travel Pass loyalty program. Encourage guests to enroll in the program and book future reservations directly with the hotel to receive member benefits and the best available rates.

Here are some points regarding audit run and no show please go through once:
* So on Friday night and Saturday night - audit run time is 5am and for rest of the week its 4am
* Also after running the audit we download the tax report and audit then email that to night audit and nirenjan. For this you just compose one email and email it to nirenjen@holidaymanagementinc.com and nightaudit@holidaymanagementinc.com
* For the audit we mark no show the reservation for one night
* For the reservation more than ine night we check in the reservation made by 3rd party and we make sure that they have a card on file for room rentAnd the one that have direct booking we change the check in to next day
* We have received the PDF containing the property's market rates and room amenities. It has been attached to the workflow for your reference.
* Added a few points to the workflow. Please make sure to review them.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
*IMPORTANT:*
1. Process all market charges from 11:00 PM–7:00 AM and add them to *Folio 2 → Misc.* Do not charge the guest until checkout.
2. Review the *room amenities, market price list, and floor map* PDFs on the Desktop and familiarize yourself with the information.
3. Maintain separate morning handover sheets for *Guest Issues, Property Problems, and Hotel Key Incidents*.
4. Follow up on the *key dispenser issue* and update the Help Group. Also, learn the market payment/posting process from the Front Desk team and add it to the workflow documentation.
5. *Meeting notes* are saved on the desktop and are also pinned in the manager’s chat. Please go through them once and add the relevant points to the workflow as well.
6. We got 2 pdf regarding night audit and am shift operations, so go through it and work accordingly.
7. For CCAF requests, collect the guest’s name, confirmation #, stay dates, phone #, and email.
Manager will provide the CCAF form. Guest must email the completed form to the Front Desk at least 48 hours before check-in.
CCAF is mainly for business travel. For leisure requests, get approval from Ericka or the Manager first.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━---

     1.  Please note that Kiosk should only contact the front desk staff through the Sonesta group WhatsApp chat and not their personal phone numbers, especially on their days off. Manjot works Thursday–Sunday, and Jose works Monday–Wednesday.
2. Manjot and Jose are our night attendants. Their shift starts at 11 PM and they are here until 7 AM. Between the hours of 7 AM and 11 PM. There is always someone at the front desk, associates very and so does their times/hours but there’s always someone at the front desk between 7 AM and 11 PM. like was stated in previous text if there’s an issue at the hotel, please reach out to the Front desk or management thank you.
Sushil works 11:05am-11:05pm every night with the exception of Tuesdays. You will want to call the front desk at 559-222-8900 when issues arise. Saturday night was not the only night that someone tried to contact Manjot during her time off.
3. Moving forward, ensure that any overnight check-in issues or concerns are also shared with the front desk email address: [sonestafresnoes@gmail.com], as requested.
